title.en: What leaves a class follows its line

statement.en: Under a class constant up to the net's end, what leaves the class at a member follows every alike step that goes on, and a step with nothing outside breaks constancy; such a class can leave a member's effects out.
statement.zh: 于至网之终有常之类下，一员处出类者随每一同类而有所缘之步，无类外者之步破其有常；此类可不持一员之所缘。

laws.en: Under a class constant up to the net's end, where a member conditions something not alike to it, every occurrence alike to the member that conditions anything conditions something alike to that effect and outside the class, every one on its line in particular. This is nearly the definition read at a member whose effects the class does not hold.
laws.zh: 于至网之终有常之类下，一员缘一不与之同类者时，凡与此员同类而有所缘者，皆缘一与该者同类而在类外者，其线上之每一者尤然。此几即定义，读于类不持其所缘之员。

laws.en: Where an occurrence alike to such a member conditions something but nothing alike to its outside effect, the class is not constant up to the net's end; a witness.
laws.zh: 与此员同类之一事有所缘而无与其类外之效同类者时，该类不至网之终有常；有见证。
declarations: Becoming.«出类不随则不至终有常»

laws.en: In a finite net without cycles, a class holding a member and part of what follows it is constant up to the net's end though not constant, does not hold the member's effects, and something outside it follows every step of its line that goes on.
laws.zh: 于无环之有限之网中，含一员及其后之一部之类，至网之终有常而非有常，不持此员之所缘，其线上每一有所缘之步皆有类外者随之。

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier, relation and class; the witnesses' nets supplied, with discrete steps and equality on their carriers.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：对一切载体、关系与类；见证之网为所给，设离散之步与载体上之相等。

does_not_show.en: That any effect is intended: the laws concern any class that does not hold a member's effects, and the agent reading is a reading.
does_not_show.zh: 任何效为所意：诸律关乎任何不持一员所缘之类，以之读行动者为一读法。

does_not_show.en: That what leaves the class is of one kind beyond what the class distinguishes, or forms a regularity of its own.
does_not_show.zh: 出类者于类所别之外为同一种，或自成一理。

does_not_show.en: That the necessary condition suffices for constancy up to the net's end: for a class with more than two blocks it does not (a three-block net, checked in the IV3 line's review of PF2).
does_not_show.zh: 此必要条件足以至网之终有常：类多于二块时不足（三块之网，见 IV3 线对 PF2 之审查）。

does_not_show.en: Whether intention fixes whose losses count (the path's P4).
does_not_show.zh: 所意能否定谁之所失计入（此路之 P4）。

next_delta.en: Answered for P2 in constancy-read-at-a-members-class (OC1): read at one's own class, with the split asking least, P2 asks of a class that does not hold a member's effects only that what stays and what leaves follow every alike step that goes on. What remains is P4's question, put to philosophers.
next_delta.zh: P2 之问于 constancy-read-at-a-members-class（OC1）得答：读于自之类、二分所问最少时，P2 于不持员之所缘之类唯问留者与出者皆随每一同类而有所缘之步。所余为 P4 之问，交哲学家。

correspondence.en: Read with a class drawn by what a member intends, the agential self of the path: it can pass P2, and then is never clean, so P2 does not exclude it and P4 carries the crux. A second round of philosophical work is in the PF2 study.
correspondence.zh: 以所意划之类读之，即此路之行动者之自：可过 P2，过则必不净，故 P2 不排除之，关键在 P4。哲学之第二轮工作见 PF2 之研究。
